title: Many folders in one go
story: Your RFdiffusion script expects its outputs in {{project}}/runs/{{run}}/outputs/pdbs, and it won't create the folders itself. Make the whole path with one command.
hints: Plain `mkdir` fails when the folders above don't exist yet. It has an option to make the parents too.
`mkdir -p runs/{{run}}/outputs/pdbs` makes every missing folder on the way.
